name: copilot-agent-manager
description: Live, read-only monitor for your GitHub Copilot agent sessions — the agent tree, every subagent, activity, tokens, diffs, and full-text conversation search in a VS Code sidebar.
author: Damilola Onadeinde

commands.title: Copilot Agents: Open in Editor (full screen)
Copilot Agents: Toggle Scope (Workspace / All Projects)
Copilot Agents: Cycle Layout (Tree / Cards / Split)

copilotAgentManager.copilotHome.markdownDescription: Path to your Copilot home directory. Leave empty to use `COPILOT_HOME` or `~/.copilot`.

copilotAgentManager.scope.description: Show sessions for the current workspace folder only, or across all projects.

copilotAgentManager.defaultLayout.description: Which of the three layouts to show by default.

copilotAgentManager.activeThresholdSecon.description: An agent whose session events were modified within this many seconds is considered running.

copilotAgentManager.includeChatStore.description: Also read VS Code chat sessions (native chatSessions files and Copilot's session-store.db), so editor chat sessions appear next to CLI sessions.

copilotAgentManager.maxSessions.description: Maximum number of recent sessions to monitor at once.

copilotAgentManager.maxLogLines.description: Maximum number of log lines kept per agent in the live view.

copilotAgentManager.pollSeconds.description: Fallback polling interval (seconds) used alongside the file watcher.

copilotAgentManager.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when a running agent finishes or errors.

scripts.test: node esbuild.js --tests && node --test out/tests/events.test.js out/tests/model.test.js out/tests/sqlite.test.js out/tests/chatStore.test.js out/tests/vscodeChats.test.js
